async def act(page):
    # Navigate directly to the product reviews page using a relative URL
    await page.goto("/admin/review/product/index/")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # On the reviews page, look for a filter or search input to find 'disappointed'
    search_box = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search", exact=False)
    if await search_box.count() > 0:
        await search_box.fill("disappointed")
        await search_box.press("Enter")
    else:
        filter_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Filter", exact=False)
        if await filter_button.count() > 0:
            await filter_button.click()
            await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
            review_filter = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Review", exact=False)
            if await review_filter.count() > 0:
                await review_filter.fill("disappointed")
                apply_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Apply", exact=False)
                if await apply_button.count() > 0:
                    await apply_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # After filtering, find the number of reviews displayed
    count_element = page.get_by_text("review", exact=False)
    if await count_element.count() > 0:
        count_text = await count_element.first.text_content()
        print(count_text)
    else:
        print("No review count found.")
